'''Trueblood''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] living during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SM1" /> A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Trueblood was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] fully-grown.<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> he served in the [[Mission to Kynachi]] with a group of clone troopers which earned the moniker of [[Breakout Squad]].<ref name="SM1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trueblood appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''.<ref name="SM1" />

*''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]'' {{1st}}
